per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The product shall integrate with the existing Choice Parts database feed and use that data rather than recreating the inventory.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product shall interface with the Choice Parts System. This provides the feed of recycled parts data.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: From a user's perspective, the parts availability data presented shall feel current via near-real-time or frequent synchronization with the Choice Parts feed.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product shall interface with the Choice Parts System. This provides the feed of recycled parts data.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The application shall conform to the organization's architecture playbook, UI standards, approved authentication patterns, visual components, and accessibility expectations.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product shall comply with corporate User Interface Guidelines'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: Access to claim-related data, ratings, and administrative functions shall be role-based with least-privilege controls: adjusters/estimators limited to claim-relevant details, auditors and program administrators granted broader historical and configuration access as appropriate.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product shall comply with insurance regulations regarding claims processing.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall prevent non-compliant recycled-parts choices where possible and clearly flag others, recording any exceptions in an auditable trail.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product shall comply with the estimatics laws relating to recycled parts usage.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall provide an auditable history of actions, ratings, and exceptions to support audits and investigations.
Parts search responses shall return within 15 seconds or less; facility search (preferred repair facility by location) shall return within 10 seconds, with a business boundary target of 8 seconds.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The search for recycled parts shall take no longer than 15 seconds. The search results shall be returned in under 15 seconds.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall achieve approximately 98% availability (uptime) over the year; tolerating more than a couple percent downtime is unacceptable.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product shall achieve a 98% uptime. The product shall not fail more than 2% of the available online time.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The application shall be responsive and lightweight on mobile devices and shall degrade gracefully under flaky cellular connections; offline mode is a desirable stretch goal but not required initially.

The system shall implement a hybrid caching strategy for Choice Parts data: prefer freshest data but use cached snapshots in poor connectivity areas to preserve availability and avoid exposing stale/inconsistent results.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product shall interface with the Choice Parts System. This provides the feed of recycled parts data.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: Help and contextual guidance shall be available on approximately 90% of screens/workflows to minimize support calls and protect first-call resolution metrics.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The user shall easily locate instructions while using the product. User help can be found within 90% of the system.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: Ease-of-use target: at least 95% of adjusters and collision estimators shall report the product is easy to use in post-rollout surveys.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product shall be easy to use by Adjusters and Collision Estimators. 95% of Adjusters and Collision Estimators shall find the product easy to use.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: Rating data shall influence recommendations in near real-time or at least on a daily cadence so adjusters rely on up-to-date performance signals when selecting facilities.
The system shall provide mechanisms to prevent misuse of ratings and reputation data (e.g., restrict who can change ratings and who can view aggregated/unredacted ratings).
The product shall be designed to avoid exposing sensitive claim information to users who do not require it for their role; field users should only see claim-relevant details.

The system shall be highly reliable such that frequent outages do not force users to revert to legacy processes; incidents of search slowness or stale availability must be minimized as they occur several times a month today.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product shall achieve a 98% uptime. The product shall not fail more than 2% of the available online time.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall avoid introducing additional governance or regulatory risk by ensuring suggested workflows comply with estimatics and insurance claims processing regulations.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product shall comply with insurance regulations regarding claims processing.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall surface help content inline and where users expect it rather than directing them to external/outdated documents, preventing unnecessary support calls.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The user shall easily locate instructions while using the product. User help can be found within 90% of the system.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: To measure success beyond user satisfaction, the system shall enable tracking of business KPIs: claim cycle time, percentage reuse of recycled parts, number of shop visits due to missing parts, and amount of manual administrative work.
If corporate architecture/UI rules are not followed, or integration with Choice Parts cannot be implemented, the project shall be considered a non-starter.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product shall interface with the Choice Parts System. This provides the feed of recycled parts data.'
